newsitem.title: USA: Boeing, McDonnell Douglas to merge - CNN.
newsitem.headline: Boeing, McDonnell Douglas to merge - CNN.

text.p: Boeing and McDonnell Douglas will announce the merger of their two companies at a noon press conference on Sunday, creating the world's largest aerospace company, CNN said, quoting sources.
CNN said the new company would have a worth of $40 billion.
The president chairman and chief executive officer of McDonnell Douglas, Harry Stonecipher, was expected to become the president and CEO of the new company, CNN said its sources told the network.
Phil Condit, the CEO of Boeing, was slated to become the chairman of the board of the new company, CNN said, according to its sources.
The two companies, Boeing specialising in commercial aircraft, and McDonnell Douglas, which specialises in miitary aircraft, have been known to be in merger discussions.
A company spokesman at Boeing declined comment on the report.
